Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models (2307.09288v1) · paper method: On the paper’s helpfulness prompt set, Llama 2-Chat 70B has a reported 36% win rate and 31.5% tie rate relative to ChatGPT.

cohort5.claim.llama2.human-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • ChatGPT is gpt-3.5-turbo-0301; approximately 4,000 helpfulness prompts, three raters per prompt. This is a historical prompt-set comparison.
  • Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat ModelsLocator: Physical PDF p19 Results lines9-12 (numeric result) AND physical PDF p18 section3.4.2 lines65-74 (comparison model identity) AND physical PDF p19 Figure12 caption lines1-2 (prompt count and raters); anchor physical p19, pdftotext-layout line 10 (1-based). Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models (2307.09288v1) · paper method: Iterative reward-ranked sampling selects the best-scoring answer per prompt; later iterations reuse top samples from earlier rounds to mitigate observed forgetting.
